title: SK Hynix Plunges as Semiconductor Selloff Deepens; Kospi Triggers Circuit Breaker
summary: SK Hynix plunged more than 10% in Seoul while Samsung Electronics fell over 8%, with South Korea's Kospi triggering a 20-minute trading halt. The rout deepened amid mounting concerns over circular AI financing and rising competition from China's low-cost AI models (Kimi K3) that could reduce future HBM demand. Tokyo Electron and Advantest also fell over 9% and 8% respectively.
why: SK海力士为存储赛道核心标的，今日A股南方两倍做多海力士ETF（CSOP相关）跌超24%；HBM需求前景突变直接影响相关持仓估值，期权隐含波动率急剧上升，持有相关sell put需评估下行风险

title: Chip Rout Deepens on AI Funding Worry, China Competition — Nvidia Falls 5%
summary: Nvidia fell 5% as investors raised alarm over circular AI financing: Nvidia's $500B AI memory deal with SK Hynix plus a $250B computing lease commitment for OpenAI created interlocking deals that could unravel if hyperscalers curb capital spending. Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and Apple earnings this week are critical for gauging whether AI infrastructure capex remains durable.
why: 英伟达持仓面临直接压力；若本周超大规模云厂商财报资本开支数据不及预期，将进一步压制AI芯片全板块估值；循环融资担忧一旦成真，相关AI基础设施押注需重新定价

title: China Says US Pledged to Cap Replacement Tariffs on Chinese Goods at 20%
summary: China's Commerce Ministry disclosed the US has committed to cap replacement tariffs on Chinese goods at 20%, ahead of the expiry of the temporary 10% Section 122 global duties. The US is simultaneously launching a new tariff wave targeting China and more than 50 other economies. Xi is expected to visit the US as bilateral trade talks continue.
why: 关税上限20%的承诺为港股/A股出海板块提供短期托底（拼多多Temu、小米、蜜雪冰城等）；新框架税率仍高于当前10%，中长期出口成本压力持续；中美峰会前后情绪窗口值得把握

title: Nvidia Locks Down $500B+ AI Memory and Factory Deal With SK Group; Circular Financing Concerns Emerge
summary: Nvidia and SK Group announced a $500B+ strategic partnership on July 25 covering a 2GW Vera Rubin AI factory and long-term HBM supply via SK Hynix. Combined with Nvidia's concurrent $250B computing lease commitment for OpenAI, investors are questioning whether these circular AI financing arrangements create systemic risk should hyperscaler capex slow — a concern directly driving today's global chip selloff.
why: 延续报道：7月25日宣布的大单是本轮全球半导体崩跌的直接导火索；英伟达持仓在循环融资担忧未消散前承压，同时HBM长期供应合同若AI需求放缓将成SK海力士的双刃剑

title: Trip.com Fined ¥5.2 Billion in China Antitrust Case; Shares Jump as Regulatory Overhang Clears
summary: China's State Administration for Market Regulation fined Trip.com Group ¥5.2 billion for abusing its dominant position in online hotel booking — enforcing exclusive lowest-price arrangements with hotels and withholding booking deposits. Despite the substantial fine, Trip.com's Hong Kong shares rallied as the market viewed the regulatory cloud as lifted, with management holding a conference call on July 27.
why: 大额反垄断罚款落地消除监管不确定性，类似阿里2021年被罚后的股价修复逻辑；罚款短期影响现金流，对持有TCOM/9961.HK期权策略需重新评估行权价下行风险及delta敞口

title: Intel Q2 2026: Revenue Up 25% — Fastest Growth in ~15 Years; 18A Yields Hit ~85%, DCAI Up 59%
summary: Intel's Q2 revenue of $16.1B beat guidance by $1.8B with adjusted EPS of $0.42 vs. guided $0.20. The Data Center & AI segment rose 59% YoY; Foundry revenue grew 31% to $5.8B with 18A process yields climbing to ~85%. Despite the strong beat, INTC fell 28% in July before rebounding, as investors weigh a capex increase to over $20B and limited external foundry revenue of $293M.
why: 延续报道：财报大超预期但股价深度回调，显示市场对晶圆代工商业化时间线仍持怀疑；在当前芯片崩跌环境下，18A良率加速可能使英特尔成为逆势标的；capex大幅上调进一步强化AI基础设施循环融资叙事
